patch_description:
This version replaces the local active-gradient island search with a deterministic global differential-evolution search followed by several constrained epigraph SLSQP refinements. Differential evolution explores distinct orientation chambers and point-ordering patterns globally instead of committing early to a single aggregate gradient direction. The final nonlinear programs maximize an explicit common lower bound on all 165 triangle determinants while preserving the discovered determinant signs.

The search works in affine simplex coordinates, uses a lower-tail objective during global exploration, applies a strong feasibility penalty for points outside the enclosing triangle, and validates every final candidate before returning it.
